final:
parity(x: int) -> int = x % 2

parities(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  pre xs.len() >= 0
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex parities([]) == []
  ex parities([1, 2, 3]) == [1, 0, 1]
  ex parities([-3, -2, 0]) == [1, 0, 0]
  let ys = par for x in xs
    parity(x)
  ys
